articles.title: Ethereum Foundation names 2 ‘must ship’ EIPs for Hegotá upgrade
articles.snippet: Ethereum’s Hegotá upgrade will center on FOCIL and Frame Transactions as developers weigh dozens of other proposed changes for inclusion.

articles.title: Polish prosecutors charge suspect in Zondacrypto probe, seek pretrial detention
articles.snippet: Polish prosecutors charged Romana Ż. with organized crime and misappropriation offenses involving $2.1 million in Zondacrypto user funds.

articles.title: Poland upholds crypto bill veto as Zondacrypto scandal widens
articles.snippet: Polish lawmakers failed to overturn a presidential veto of crypto legislation as the Zondacrypto investigation expands and its Estonian operator enters bankruptcy.

articles.title: Token buybacks are booming. But are they good for crypto projects?
articles.snippet: Crypto projects are spending hundreds of millions buying their own tokens. But are buybacks creating lasting value — or just making tokens look more valuable than they really are?

articles.title: Kalshi US visits soar 1,500% as regulatory pressure mounts
articles.snippet: Kalshi’s US web traffic climbed more than 1,500% in less than a year, while trading volume grew even faster and legal scrutiny of its sports contracts intensified.
